Specifies files and directories to ignore in Docker builds, specifically the `.venv` directory.

# Purpose
The `.venv` file is typically used to indicate the presence of a Python virtual environment in a project directory. It serves as a marker to identify that the directory contains a virtual environment, which is an isolated environment for Python projects. This allows the project to manage dependencies separately from the system-wide Python installation.
